title: "The LA Fire Was Devastating – But What About the Eternal Fire?" 🔥
paragraphs:
"The LA Fire Was Devastating – But What About the Eternal Fire?" 🔥
✝️ A Message from Brother John Domino "PiX" S. Asis – Follower of Jesus Christ and a Servant of God
🌍 The world was shaken by the devastating Los Angeles fire this week.

Hundreds of homes destroyed.
Families displaced.
Lives tragically lost.
The flames were unstoppable, consuming everything in their path. It was a horrifying reminder of how fragile life can be. But as tragic as this disaster is, it serves as a wake-up call for something far worse—the fire of eternal separation from God.
👉 If the physical flames caused so much fear… imagine the eternal fire Jesus warned us about.
📖 “If anyone’s name was not found written in the Book of Life, he was thrown into the lake of fire.” (Revelation 20:15)

🔥 Earthly Fires vs. The Eternal Fire – What Does the Bible Say?
The LA fire destroyed property. But the eternal fire described in Scripture deals with souls.
Key Differences:

🌍 Earthly Fire (Temporary)
Lasts for a time, then burns out.
Destroys buildings, possessions, and bodies.
Can be extinguished by human efforts.
🔥 Eternal Fire (Forever)
Never stops burning.
A place of separation from God’s presence.
Reserved for those who reject Jesus Christ.
No human can extinguish it—only faith in Jesus saves.
📖 “Their worm does not die, and the fire is not quenched.” (Mark 9:48)

🔥 Why Does the Bible Speak About Eternal Fire?
Many avoid this topic because it feels uncomfortable—but truth can’t be sugarcoated.

🔥 Jesus Himself warned about hell more than anyone else in Scripture.
🔥 Why? Because He came to save us from it!
📖 “For God did not send His Son into the world to condemn the world, but to save the world through Him.” (John 3:17)
👉 Hell isn’t a place where God sends good people—it’s where unrepentant sinners choose to go by rejecting Jesus.

🔥 Who Will Face the Eternal Fire?
The Bible is clear:
Not just "bad people."
Not just criminals.
But ALL who reject Jesus Christ.
📖 “All have sinned and fall short of the glory of God.” (Romans 3:23)

🔥 The Good News: Jesus Paid the Price So You Don’t Have To!
Here’s the powerful truth:

✅ You don’t have to face this eternal fire.
✅ Jesus took your punishment on the cross.
✅ He paid the FULL PRICE for your sins.
📖 “But God demonstrates His own love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.” (Romans 5:8)

✅ When you trust in Jesus, the punishment you deserve is removed.
✅ Your name is written in the Book of Life.
📖 “Therefore, there is now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus.” (Romans 8:1)

🔥 What Must You Do to Be Saved?
You cannot save yourself. Being a good person won’t erase your sin.
Salvation comes ONLY through Jesus Christ.
✅ 1. Admit You Are a Sinner.

“For all have sinned.” (Romans 3:23)
✅ 2. Believe in Jesus’ Sacrifice.

“Believe in the Lord Jesus, and you will be saved.” (Acts 16:31)
✅ 3. Trust in Jesus Alone.

“It is by grace you have been saved, through faith... not by works.” (Ephesians 2:8-9)
🔥 Don’t Ignore the Warning – Hell Is Real
The LA fire was a tragedy. Lives were lost, homes destroyed.
But eternal separation from God is far more terrifying.
👉 You don't have to go there.
📖 “God is patient with you, not wanting anyone to perish but everyone to come to repentance.” (2 Peter 3:9)

📜 FAITH DECLARATION FOR JANUARY 15, 2025 📜
"Today, I choose Jesus Christ as my Savior. I reject the lie that being 'good enough' can save me. I place my full faith in Jesus’ finished work on the cross for my salvation and eternal life."

🔥 THE “ESCAPE THE FLAMES” CHALLENGE 🔥
✅ Step 1: Reflect on your eternal security.
✅ Step 2: Share this truth with someone today.
✅ Step 3: Tag 3 friends who need to hear the Gospel.

🌌 TODAY IS THE DAY OF SALVATION – CHOOSE JESUS NOW 🌌
👉 The LA Fire was sudden and terrifying.
👉 Eternity could be even closer than you think.
📖 “How shall we escape if we ignore so great a salvation?” (Hebrews 2:3)

🙏 PRAYER FOR JANUARY 15, 2025 🙏
Heavenly Father,
Thank You for sending Jesus to rescue me from the eternal punishment I deserve. I confess I am a sinner, unable to save myself. Today, I place my full trust in Jesus Christ alone for my salvation. Keep my heart focused on eternity and use me to warn others of the truth.
In Jesus’ name, Amen. ✝️
